item.title: What’s Your Favorite Peabo Bryson Hot 100 Hit? Vote!
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We're taking a look at the legendary career of Peabo Bryson, known for his velvety smooth voice and iconic collaborations.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: With 12 Hot 100 hits under his belt, Peabo Bryson was the king of collaborations in the 1990s. Seven of those hits were duets with top artists, including Regina Belle and Roberta Flack. But sadly, we've just learned that Bryson has suffered a stroke and is currently under medical care.
[Music pauses for a brief moment]
Host: Bryson is perhaps best known for his duets "Beauty and the Beast" with Celine Dion and "A Whole New World (Aladdin's Theme)" with Regina Belle. Both songs, composed by Alan Menken for Disney blockbusters, won back-to-back Oscars for best original song. He also took home back-to-back Grammy Awards for best pop duo/group collaboration for these hits.
[Music transitions to a softer melody]
Host: As we send our thoughts and prayers to Peabo Bryson and his family, we want to hear from you. What's your favorite Peabo Bryson hit? Take a look at his 12 Hot 100 hits and let us know. We'll be back with more music news after this break.
[Outro music plays]
